text: The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
H-hey, I said wait! How many times do I have to\ntell you to wait for us?!
A way...\nThe way to the tower where the old scientist is...\nBut it looks like it's damaged.
Aye? Maybe we can go through?
Yeah, you should take things easy!
Ugh, what a dark and creepy underground passage~.
Are those scratches on the wall from a sword\nfight? I wonder if some violent battle took place\nhere.
Indeed, there are traces of battle everywhere~.\nIt's almost as if there was a war!
There's the exit! Finally! After all that time\nunderground, I really need to breathe some fresh\nair!
The traces of battle here are terrible too.\nWhat exactly happened here?
You're right, let's go!\nMaybe we'll find the answer if we keep going!
